scripts.build: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:server: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server run build
scripts.build:client: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/client run build
scripts.build:raycast: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter tracktime-raycast run build
scripts.dev:raycast: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter tracktime-raycast run dev
scripts.build:extension: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run build
scripts.build:extension:prod: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm --filter @starter/extension run build:prod
scripts.openapi:emit: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/server exec tsx src/api/v1/emit-openapi.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @starter/core run test && pnpm --filter @starter/server run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @starter/shared run build && pnpm --filter @starter/core run build && pnpm -r --filter '!@starter/shared' --filter '!@starter/core' run typecheck && pnpm typecheck:electron
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "PORT=7130 pnpm --filter @starter/client dev" "wait-on http://localhost:7130 && pnpm electron:compile && ELECTRON_DEV_URL=http://localhost:7130 electron electron/main.js"
scripts.cap:run:ios: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap run ios --no-sync
scripts.cap:run:android: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cap run android --no-sync
scripts.build:ios:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android:release: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
